selector.rationale: The presence of a painful, erosive lesion around the stoma with histopathology showing suprabasal epidermal splitting and acantholysis, along with high levels of IgG autoantibodies against desmoglein 1 and 3, supports the diagnosis of pemphigus vulgaris, but the localized nature of the lesion around the stoma specifically points towards Peristomal localized pemphigus vulgaris.

rejected.label: Paraneoplastic pemphigus
rejected.why: There is no mention of an underlying neoplasm, which is typically associated with paraneoplastic pemphigus.
